M1.reason: The outline is recognisably the zombie's, but every view is under the 0.80 overlap line: front/back 0.766, left/right 0.716 and top/below 0.472. In the left and right views the original hunches forward with its head and shoulders pushed ahead and its arms hanging in front. The reproduction stands upright, its back nearly straight, and one arm reaches out stiffly. From the top and below, the reproduction's arms and claws spread to different places from the original's, which is why that pair overlaps only 0.47.

M2.reason: The measured size is 38.8 x 54.7 x 68.8 against 38.5 x 53.8 x 68.4. Every axis is within 2% of the original (off by 0.01, 0.018 and 0.006), well inside 10%.

M3.reason: All the main parts are there and in place: the headcrab over the head, the bloodied lab coat with the opened chest at the front, the ribcage wounds on the back, the long clawed hands, the trousers and the shoes. Some parts have the wrong shape. The original's fingers are hooked and curled, with red tips, but the reproduction's claws are straight, thin spikes that fan out, best seen front, front-left and below. The reproduction's shoes are flat-topped and boxy, where the original's are rounded red shoes (left, right and back views).

M4.reason: The measured mean deltaE is 8.4, and every view is under 10, against a line of 15. Each region has the original's colour and material: a white-grey cloth coat and trousers with red blood, a yellow-tan headcrab, dark red flesh on the arms and red shoes. The coat is a shade greyer and the headcrab a little paler from the front, but both are still the same colour.

M5.reason: The blood spatter on the coat and trousers, the gaping chest cavity and the two ribcage wounds on the back are all there and in their places. The texture is smeared and stretched in places, though. In the right and front-right views the coat and legs show vertical streaks, and the white seams at the collar and cuffs are visible. The ribcage and chest detail is softer than the original's, best seen in the back-right view.

M6.reason: At game size a player would see a Half-Life zombie, but not take this for the original side by side. The upright stance and the stiff, outstretched arm stand out against the original's hunched, dangling-armed pose, and the spiky claw fans read differently from the original's hooked hands.

M7.reason: The front matches the original's front. The model is upright and stands with its feet on the ground line at its origin, as the original does, in every view and every walk frame.

M8.reason: SMAK's check reported no errors. It has 1084 triangles against the original's 844, under the limit of twice the original (1688). Nothing is open, inside out or floating in any view.

C1.reason: Through the walk (walk2handed, 23 frames) every part stays on the body, and the feet stay on the ground line: nothing comes apart, sinks or floats. It does not move as the original does, though. The original's arms dangle and swing loosely in front of a hunched torso, but the reproduction keeps one arm held straight out forward and its torso upright in every frame, a two-handed carrying walk rather than the zombie's shamble.
